protocol.sweep_endpoint: At dose 4, mean of the evidence-minus-format acknowledgment receiver contrasts over the two new direction pairs and three existing mixed adapters; original receiver subtracted per pair.
protocol.control_endpoint: At dose 4 on direction pair A, evidence-minus-format acknowledgment change for newly trained mixed minus benign-only adapters, paired within seed and averaged across the three seeds.
protocol.secondary: Per-dose and per-calibration sweep estimates, per-seed contrasts, safety-only versus benign-only and mixed versus safety-only, unsupported assertions, separate reviewer streams, and complete-prompt uncapped sensitivity. Pointwise secondary intervals are descriptive.
